periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45-55 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical elongation approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering, with the lower half of the patch narrowing toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped profile along the posterior edge of the dark band across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible torso length from the neck to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap, approximately equivalent to the width of the forehead between the medial edges of the ears.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular top boundaries on both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct yellowish-beige tint in the white pelage of the dorsal region posterior to the dark band, contrasting with the cleaner white of the face.
